backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor implementing a music portfolio backend with role-based access control; admins can add/update/delete music entries while authenticated users manage profiles, and public queries support catalog browsing and search.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that defines the MusicEntry and StreamingPlatform types and provides a no-op migration function passing old actor state directly to the new actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (admin panel, LNT rebranding, auto-refresh catalog, navigation) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, pages, hooks, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base layers and OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, card, and chart color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'LNT | MakeItHappen.com' and mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with two routes (/ for MusicCatalog, /admin for AdminPanel), wraps the app in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider, and renders a shared Layout shell.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: Full-width hero banner component displaying the 'LNT' brand headline and 'MakeItHappen.com' tagline over a dark gradient overlay with gold decorative accents.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Shell layout component that composes the Navigation bar, ProfileSetupModal, main content outlet, and a branded footer with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/MusicCard.tsx: Card component rendering a music entry's cover image with hover zoom, genre badge, title, artist/album/year metadata, and streaming platform buttons in a dark-themed layout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with the LNT brand logo, links to Music and Admin pages, and an Internet Identity login/logout button with mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Displays a modal dialog prompting newly authenticated users to enter their name and save a profile, shown only when the user is logged in but has no existing profile.
frontend/src/components/SearchBar.tsx: A controlled search input component with a clear button that also displays a result count summary when a search query is active.
frontend/src/components/StreamingPlatfor: Renders styled external-link buttons for each streaming platform (Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music, etc.) associated with a music entry, using platform-specific icons and colors.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) via React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the user's identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity persistence, and login status state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating music entries and user profiles against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Bebas Neue, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes including platform colors, sidebar, and chart variables. Also defines utility classes for gold glow effects and card hover animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page gated behind Internet Identity authentication, allowing the owner to add new music entries (with title, artist, album, cover image, release year, genre, and streaming platform links) and delete existing ones using form components and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/MusicCatalog.tsx: Public music catalog page that fetches all music entries, renders a hero banner, search bar, and a responsive grid of MusicCard components with loading skeletons and empty/error states.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to extract URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persist them to sessionStorage, and clean sensitive parameters from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom fonts (Bebas Neue, Inter), oklch-based color tokens (gold, surface, platform, sidebar, chart), border radius variables, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file describing the LNT music portfolio app's architecture, existing features (catalog, admin panel, search, theming, branding), and image requirements for the LNT logo.
